description: [Tauri Apps Only] Start/stop automation session to connect to a RUNNING Tauri app. Supports multiple concurrent app connections - each app runs on a unique port. The most recently connected app becomes the "default" app used when no appIdentifier is specified. Use action "status" to check connection state: returns single app format when 1 app connected, or array format with "isDefault" indicator when multiple apps connected. Action "stop" without appIdentifier stops ALL sessions; with appIdentifier stops only that app. The identifier field (e.g., "com.example.myapp") uniquely identifies each app. REQUIRED before using other webview_* or ipc_* tools. Connects via WebSocket to the MCP Bridge plugin in the Tauri app. For browser automation, use Chrome DevTools MCP instead. For Electron apps, this tool will NOT work.

action.description: Action to perform: start or stop the session, or check status

appIdentifier.description: App identifier (port number or bundle ID) to stop. Only used with action "stop". If omitted, stops all sessions.

host.description: Host address to connect to (e.g., 192.168.1.100). Falls back to MCP_BRIDGE_HOST or TAURI_DEV_HOST env vars

name: driver_session
